import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Create a DataFrame from the dataset
data = {
    'survived': [0, 1, 1, 1, 0],
    'pclass': [3, 1, 3, 1, 3],
    'sex': ['male', 'female', 'female', 'female', 'male'],
    'age': [22.0, 38.0, 26.0, 35.0, 35.0],
    'sibsp': [1, 1, 0, 1, 0],
    'parch': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'fare': [7.25, 71.2833, 7.925, 53.1, 8.05],
    'embarked': ['S', 'C', 'S', 'S', 'S'],
    'class': ['Third', 'First', 'Third', 'First', 'Third'],
    'who': ['man', 'woman', 'woman', 'woman', 'man'],
    'adult_male': [True, False, False, False, True],
    'deck': [None, 'C', None, 'C', None],
    'embark_town': ['Southampton', 'Cherbourg', 'Southampton', 'Southampton', 'Southampton'],
    'alive': ['no', 'yes', 'yes', 'yes', 'no'],
    'alone': [False, False, True, False, True]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a count plot for survival based on class and sex
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(data=df, x='pclass', hue='sex', palette='pastel', edgecolor='black')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Survival Count by Class and Sex')
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Sex')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
